verdict.rationale: Floot is an AI app builder, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of such a policy or setting. The security-and-data page cited only covers SQL dump exports, which is a related but different data-portability feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
